prompts.plus: Create a NEW 3:2 landscape illustration for the PLUS monthly real estate media plan. Use the attached image ONLY as reference for tactile miniature realism, soft daylight, warm cream/terracotta/ink palette and immaculate product photography. This new composition must be immediately distinct from the reference. Exactly TWO separate complete miniature South Florida homes, similar modest scale, clearly distinguishable as two properties with space between them: a terracotta-roof stucco house on the left and a pale contemporary flat-roof home on the right. Compose both prominently on a single cream studio floor, with small palms behind. Foreground: a black smartphone on a compact filming tripod showing a vertical home video, and two small editorial photo prints. No drone (this plan has drone only as an optional add-on). No words, lettering, logos, numerals, watermarks or price tags. No humans. Preserve complete objects with comfortable edge margins; no crop, no collage panels, no oversized camera obscuring either house. Refined coherent finished editorial illustration, not a website mockup. Use the full image, no blank banner. Output 1536x1024 visual proportions.
